source.source_name: Provincial corporate registries (Québec REQ, BC OrgBook, Ontario, Alberta, ...)

parsing.notes: Umbrella source — implement per province. Québec REQ (Données Québec, open; NEQ) and BC OrgBook (open API) are the strong open ones; Ontario/Alberta etc. vary (some paid). Join to federal via BN/name.

mapping_rules.company_id: Use the provincial registry number (e.g. Québec NEQ); namespace by province.
mapping_rules.tax_id: Use the Business Number (BN) where present.
mapping_rules.join: BN (where shared) or name; companies here are NOT in the federal dataset.

live_test_plan.smoke: For each open province, fetch one record (Québec Données Québec CSV; BC OrgBook API).
live_test_plan.full: Per-province ingestion behind env gates; budget for paid provinces; merge with federal by BN.

blockers: 13 separate jurisdictions; access/format/licence vary per province.
Some provinces (Ontario, Alberta) charge for searches/bulk.
Director/officer data (where present) is personal data.
